aiPlan.coachNarrative: This plan is tailored for Numan Faisal's recomposition goal, providing enough protein and calories to support muscle growth while staying within a low‑budget grocery list. The push‑focused bodyweight workout substitutes classic barbell and dumbbell moves with progressive push‑up variations, ensuring safe overload without equipment. The meals use ultra‑cheap staples and hit the target macros within the allowed ranges.
aiPlan.workoutFocus: Push: Chest, Front/Side Delts, Triceps (Bodyweight Substitutions)
workoutCues: Prioritize strict form on each push‑up variation; keep core tight and elbows at ~45° to protect shoulders.
Progress overload by adding reps, slowing tempo (e.g., 3‑0‑1), or wearing a backpack with weight as you adapt.
Rest 60‑90 seconds between sets; maintain a controlled tempo to maximize muscle tension.

meals.recipeTitle: Hearty Oatmeal with Eggs, Banana, Peanut Butter & Cottage Cheese
ingredients: Low‑fat cottage cheese – ½ cup (≈110 g)
instructions: Cook oats in water until soft.
Scramble the whole egg and egg whites in a non‑stick pan.
Stir the cooked eggs into the oatmeal, slice the banana on top, and drizzle peanut butter.
Serve cottage cheese on the side.
meals.youtubeSearch: oatmeal with egg banana peanut butter recipe

meals.recipeTitle: Chicken‑Lentil Rice Bowl with Veggies & Peanut Butter
instructions: Season and grill or bake the chicken thigh; slice into strips.
Cook lentils until tender.
Steam mixed vegetables.
Combine rice, lentils, chicken, and veggies in a bowl; stir in peanut butter for extra calories.
Mix the cooked rice with peanut butter until evenly coated.
Slice the banana and serve alongside.
Quickly whisk the egg white and add to the rice mixture for a protein boost (optional).
